# cancho-ml

> Fit, apply, score and serve classical machine-learning models on a CSV, with refusals an agent can read: a rule tag, an exit code and a repair.

- [agents.md](agents.md): this tool as an agent reads it: ask `ml skill` and `ml introspect`, the shape of an answer and a refusal, the verbs, what holds and what is not claimed
- [guide.html](guide.html): every flow with its real output
- [evidence.html](evidence.html): the gates, the oracles and the mutants
- [docs/cli.md](https://github.com/alpibrusl/cancho-ml/blob/main/docs/cli.md): the reference
